tests: <sl-tooltip> > should be visible with the open attribute
<sl-tooltip> > should not be visible without the open attribute
<sl-tooltip> > should emit sl-show and sl-after-show when calling show()
<sl-tooltip> > should emit sl-hide and sl-after-hide when calling hide()

<sl-tooltip> > should emit sl-hide and sl-after-hide when setting open = false

<sl-tooltip> > should not accept user selection on the tooltip
